description: System and field power input monitor (ioThinx 45MR-7210, -T): system power status and alarm limits, field power status
source: Moxa, ioThinx 4510 Series User's Manual, version 2.1 (August 2019), Appendix A: 45MR-7210(-T), System and Field Power Input Registers
notes: Modbus/TCP through the ioThinx 4510 adapter, port 502. The addresses are relative to the module: the address on the wire is the start of the module's slot plus the address given here.

The manual lists the four parameters with their lengths (1, 2, 2 and 1 registers) and types, in this order, but does not say which function code or area they use or whether the limits are writable. They are listed here as holding registers, as the earlier map did, and the limits as read/write: check on a device.
The status values are 0, 1 and 2 (see the RESTful API list in the manual); their meaning is not given there.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
